arxiv-1506-08648.title: Drag induced radiative loss from semi-hard heavy quarks
arxiv-1506-08648.creator: Raktim Abir, Abhijit Majumder
arxiv-1506-08648.description: Abstract The case of gluon bremsstrahlung off a heavy quark in extended nuclear matter is revisited within the higher twist formalism. In particular, the in-medium modification of “semi-hard” heavy quarks is studied, where the momentum of the heavy quark is larger but comparable to the mass of the heavy quark ( p ≳ M p\gtrsim M ).

arxiv-2006-00671.title: Conversational Machine Comprehension: a Literature Review
arxiv-2006-00671.creator: Somil Gupta, Bhanu Pratap Singh Rawat, Hong Yu
arxiv-2006-00671.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Somil Gupta, Bhanu Pratap Singh Rawat, Hong Yu. Conversational Machine Comprehension (CMC), a research track in conversational AI, expects the machine to understand an open-domain natural language text and thereafter engage in a multi-turn conversation to answer questions related to the text.

arxiv-2105-01128.title: Fusing multimodal neuroimaging data with a variational autoencoder
arxiv-2105-01128.creator: Eloy Geenjaar, Noah Lewis, Zening Fu, Rohan Venkatdas, Sergey Plis, Vince Calhoun
arxiv-2105-01128.description: Abstract Neuroimaging studies often involve the collection of multiple data modalities. These modalities contain both shared and mutually exclusive information about the brain. This work aims at finding a scalable and interpretable method to fuse the information of multiple neuroimaging modalities using a variational autoencoder (VAE).

arxiv-2203-07822.title: On exchange matrices from string diagrams
arxiv-2203-07822.creator: Peigen Cao
arxiv-2203-07822.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Peigen Cao. Inspired by Fock-Goncharov’s amalgamation procedure [ 7 ] , Shen-Weng introduced string diagrams in [ 18 ] , which are very useful to describe many interesting skew-symmetrizable matrices closely related with Lie theory. In this paper, we prove that the skew-symmetrizable matrices from string diagrams are in the smallest class 𝒫 ′ \mathcal{P}^{\prime} of skew-symmetrizable matrices containing the 1 × 1 1\times 1 zero matrix and closed under mutations and source-sink extensions.

arxiv-2206-00268.title: The Hipster Paradox in Electronic Dance Music: How Musicians Trade Mainstream Success off against Alternative Status
arxiv-2206-00268.creator: Mohsen Jadidi, Haiko Lietz, Mattia Samory, Claudia Wagner
arxiv-2206-00268.description: Abstract The hipster paradox in Electronic Dance Music is the phenomenon that commercial success is collectively considered illegitimate while serious and aspiring professional musicians strive for it. We study this behavioral dilemma using digital traces of performing live and releasing music as they are stored in the Resident Advisor , Juno Download , and Discogs databases from 2001-2018.

arxiv-2208-00420.title: Flavor Changing Neutral Current processes and family discrimination in 3-3-1 models
arxiv-2208-00420.creator: Vinícius Oliveira a, C. A. de S. Pires a
arxiv-2208-00420.description: Abstract In 3-3-1 models anomaly cancellation requires that one of the three families of quarks transforms as triplet by SU ​ ( 3 ) L \text{SU}(3)_{\text{L}} with the other two transforming necessarily as anti-triplet. This is an important feature of the model because with it we explain family replication.

arxiv-2208-13741.title: Recursive Session Logical Relations
arxiv-2208-13741.creator: Farzaneh Derakhshan, Stephanie Balzer
arxiv-2208-13741.description: Abstract . Program equivalence is the fulcrum for reasoning about and proving properties of programs. For noninterference, for example, program equivalence up to the secrecy level of an observer is shown. A powerful enabler for such proofs are logical relations . Logical relations only recently were adopted for session types—but exclusively for terminating languages.

arxiv-2211-06367.description: Abstract When accreting X-ray pulsars (XRPs) undergo bright X-ray outbursts, their luminosity-dependent spectral and timing features can be analyzed in detail. The XRP GRO J1750-27 recently underwent one such episode, during which it was observed with NuSTAR and monitored with NICER .

Budiardja, Dmytro Bykov, Noel Chalmers, Jacqueline Chen, Nicholas Curtis, Marc Day, Markus Eisenbach, Lucas Esclapez, Alessandro Fanfarillo, William Freitag, Nicholas Frontiere, Antigoni Georgiadou, Joseph Glenski, Kalyana Gottiparthi, Marc T. arxiv-2410-04810.title: FedBiP: Heterogeneous One-Shot Federated Learning with Personalized Latent Diffusion Models
arxiv-2410-04810.creator: Haokun Chen, Hang Li, Yao Zhang, Jinhe Bi, Gengyuan Zhang, Yueqi Zhang, Philip Torr, Jindong Gu, Denis Krompass, Volker Tresp
arxiv-2410-04810.description: Abstract One-Shot Federated Learning (OSFL), a special decentralized machine learning paradigm, has recently gained significant attention. OSFL requires only a single round of client data or model upload, which reduces communication costs and mitigates privacy threats compared to traditional FL.

arxiv-2501-08682.title: RealVVT: Towards Photorealistic Video Virtual Try-on via Spatio-Temporal Consistency
arxiv-2501-08682.creator: Siqi Li, Zhengkai Jiang, Jiawei Zhou, Zhihong Liu, Xiaowei Chi, Haoqian Wang
arxiv-2501-08682.description: Abstract Virtual try-on has emerged as a pivotal task at the intersection of computer vision and fashion, aimed at digitally simulating how clothing items fit on the human body. Despite notable progress in single-image virtual try-on (VTO), current methodologies often struggle to preserve a consistent and authentic appearance of clothing across extended video sequences.

arxiv-2501-17220.title: The initial-to-final mass relation of white dwarfs in intermediate-separation binaries Facilities: Gaia, GALEX, 2MASS, WISE
arxiv-2501-17220.creator: Oren Ironi, Sagi Ben-Ami, Na’ama Hallakoun, Sahar Shahaf
arxiv-2501-17220.description: Abstract We examine the applicability of the initial-to-final mass relation (IFMR) for white dwarfs (WDs) in intermediate-separation binary systems ( ∼ \sim 1 AU), using astrometric binaries identified in open clusters from Gaia DR3. A careful analysis of the astrometric orbits and spectral energy distributions isolates 33 main-sequence (MS) stars with highly likely WD companions.

arxiv-2601-15881.title: Recovery of nonlinear material parameters in a quasilinear Lamé system
arxiv-2601-15881.creator: David Johansson, Yavar Kian
arxiv-2601-15881.description: Abstract We investigate the inverse problem of determining nonlinear elastic material parameters from boundary stress measurements corresponding to prescribed boundary displacements. The material law is described by a nonlinear, space-independent elastic tensor depending on both the displacement and the strain, and gives rise to a general class of quasilinear Lamé systems.

pmc-12966074.title: Aneurysmal Veins in Free Flaps: A Rare Case Report and Discussion
pmc-12966074.creator: Manisha Anbudurai, Louis Choon Kit Wong, Christelle Guillon, Yishan Valerie Tuang, Priya Tiwari, Yan Lin Yap, Thiam Chye Lim, Jane Lim, Vigneswaran Nallathamby, O-Wern Low
pmc-12966074.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Summary:Microvascular anastomosis is a fundamental technique in reconstructive surgery, where careful selection and meticulous handling of vessels are critical in preventing thrombosis—the leading cause of flap failure. Despite the extensive literature surrounding the topic, aneurysmal veins—typically identified incidentally on imaging or occasionally presenting with thrombosis when located in the deep veins of the extremities—are seldom encountered in the context of microsurgery due to their overall rarity. In this case report, we describe our intraoperative encounter with aneurysmal veins during free flap reconstruction.
